checks.name: isolated application and least-privilege startup
checks.detail: fresh V1-V4; real db-profile HTTP app uses approval_app without runtime Flyway, DDL/history denied

checks.name: native registration login and secret storage
checks.detail: native registration normalizes username/email; PENDING/no roles/no department; inbox atomic; Argon2id parameters and SHA-256 session digest verified

checks.name: Web CSRF Origin and credential selection
checks.detail: Web registration/login; signed pre-auth/session-bound CSRF, exact Origin, HttpOnly cookies, sid rotation; mixed/duplicate credentials rejected; client transports cannot cross

checks.name: concurrent normalized uniqueness and privilege injection
checks.detail: two synchronized normalization races each produce 201+409; role/status overposting rejected; injected inbox failure returns redacted retryable503 and rolls back both rows, then recovery succeeds

checks.name: durable concurrent account and login IP limits
checks.detail: 8 concurrent account failures => 5x401+3x429/counter=5; 24 concurrent IP attempts => 20x401+4x429/counter=20; both survive application restart

checks.name: concurrent registration IP limit
checks.detail: 12 concurrent native registrations => 10x201+2x429; exactly ten users/inboxes and durable IP counter=10

checks.name: logout and password change revocation
checks.detail: logout is idempotent and revokes only current session; password change verifies old secret and revokes all Web/native sessions; old password rejected; Web cookies expire

checks.name: forced-password and disabled-account authorization
checks.detail: SQL-forced mustChangePassword allows me/password only, changing password clears flag/revokes sessions; SQL-DISABLED user denied existing-session auth and new login (not admin API validation)

checks.name: idle and absolute session expiry
checks.detail: SQL-adjusted session clocks: 29min idle accepted, at/after 30min rejected; future absolute deadline accepted, reached deadline rejected; exact frozen-clock boundary belongs to Java unit tests

checks.name: versioned profile and confirmation resubmission
checks.detail: versioned self-profile update rejects stale version; SQL-REJECTED fixture resubmits to PENDING with user/config versions; all registered users retain inbox/no roles

checks.name: real database lock timeout and recovery
checks.detail: real user-row lock exceeds configured 3s timeout => redacted retryable HTTP503; same session succeeds after rollback releases lock

jar_execution: one private immutable copy used for migration and every application start
fixture_scope: disposable MySQL only; SQL resets limiter buckets between independent checks and sets account/session fixtures
transport_scope: loopback HTTP only; Secure=false test configuration, not TLS/deployment acceptance
scope: TASK-03 HTTP/SQL black-box only; no administrative API, no TASK09/10, no full T01-T22 acceptance promotion
